# HWDither

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [World](Blitz3D-World)

</div>


```blitzbasic
HWDither:Int32
```

**Returns:** 2 if Dither 2 dithers what blending makes, else 1.

## Description

Gives the highest value of [Dither](Dither) that does something on the graphics driver in use, or on the one that [SetGfxDriver](SetGfxDriver) chose if no graphics window is open yet. It is 2 where the GPU can blend in the fragment shader, which takes the Vulkan extensions VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering_local_read and VK_EXT_rasterization_order_attachment_access, and 1 everywhere else. Dither 2 does what Dither 1 does where this is 1, so a program can ask for 2 without looking at this; it is for programs that want to say which one they get. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such function, and Dither there only has on and off.
